added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: _plan_review_raw_reports ignores the run_id argument, so `crew gc --run <id> --apply` also prunes past-retention raw reports of runs other than the named one, which the --run flag documents as confining the sweep to one run (reckon/cli.py:6616); the harm is bounded because such a report is removed only when its content is already durable in a committed record.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 5f53ef9de; one commit adds the config key and reader (reckon/flight.py:104,736), the gc pass (reckon/crew/routing.py:1388), tests/test_raw_report_retention.py and the landing fragment, all inside scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_raw_report_retention.py with tests/test_crew_gc.py and tests/test_review_is_earned_by_significant_change.py; the manifest records that run at EXIT=0 (49 passed) and the declared negative control at EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that crew gc prunes a plan review's raw report.md past review.raw_report_retention_days only when its committed record exists, printing every candidate; reckon/crew/routing.py:1388 (_plan_review_raw_reports) implements exactly that clause.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commit 5c1d172fe, the four changed paths, the gate result 49 passed EXIT=0, the negative control EXIT=1, and leaves baseline_suite/after_suite unarmed.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/flight.py, reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_raw_report_retention.py and the evidence fragment under docs/evidence/fragments; every path in the diff is inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_raw_report_retention.py:118-135 fails when the prune branch ignores record existence - the declared negative control reddened exactly that assertion - and its filesystem assertions fail if a dry run removes or --apply stops removing.
justifications.evidence: the gate tests/test_raw_report_retention.py asserts prune-under-apply, withheld-and-kept, the 30-day default and the project-layer cutoff, and the manifest records 49 passed EXIT=0; re-running that file gave 8 passed EXIT=0.
justifications.fit: reckon/flight.py:736 raw_report_retention_days mirrors plan_review_change_threshold beside it and routing.py:1388 follows the existing _plan_review_* helper idiom, with no version, ticket or plan label in any added symbol.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/routing.py:1388 lists each past-retention report as prune only when the committed record resolves (routing.py:1441) and withheld otherwise, which is the goal clause verbatim.
justifications.reuse: the pass extends garbage_collect (routing.py:1472) and reuses plan_review.plan_review_path and committed_review_root (routing.py:1437) plus flight.resolve rather than re-deriving any path or config rule.
justifications.scope_discipline: every hunk of 5c1d172fe lands in reckon/flight.py, reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_raw_report_retention.py or the declared fragment, and no path outside the declared write paths is touched.
